mechanism: Tranylcypromine (MAOI) inhibits monoamine oxidase, increasing serotonergic and noradrenergic activity, while hydrocodone's metabolite norhydrocodone has serotonergic properties, creating risk for serotonin syndrome; combined CNS depression also increases respiratory and overdose risk.
action: Avoid combination or use only with extreme caution and close monitoring; if necessary, use lowest hydrocodone doses with frequent clinical reassessment for serotonin syndrome symptoms and respiratory depression.
